observations: the card was presented and armed
the person said "Click <option label>" for one option of that card
the OS Touch ID or password prompt appeared and the person passed it
the ask was afterwards answered with exactly that option, as shown by `deep inbox`
on one card the prompt was cancelled and the ask stayed open
the card was presented and armed
the person selected one option of that card with the switch
the OS Touch ID or password prompt appeared and the person passed it
the ask was afterwards answered with exactly that option, as shown by `deep inbox`

binding_every_item_must_carry: the tested commit's full 40-hex SHA, equal to the checkout's HEAD when the case runs
the kind id from `kinds` above (or the once-for-the-method marker)
the macOS build and the assistive technology's name
an outcome from a closed set; only `observed` counts, and an observed failure is not a pass
must_be_rejected: evidence for fewer than all seven kinds, or without the method's cancelled-prompt item
a VoiceOver item missing any of question, options, deadline or default
evidence whose commit is not the checkout's HEAD (stale, different or later commit)
evidence whose signature does not verify, whose signing key is not on the approved list read at the merge base, or whose signature carries no touch or biometric flag
evidence for a different issue, criterion, case or method than the one being judged
an item whose outcome is anything but `observed`
a duplicated item that contradicts another item
evidence that exists only as unsigned text in the working tree, in this file, in a fixture, in a README, in BASE-FAILURE.txt, in an environment variable or in an agent's message
